The Randomazzo is located to the far north of the starting area in Gallo Tower. Its location is tracked by a green arrow on the player's screen. It is guarded by enemies that fire red circular projectiles and slowing beams that rotate clockwise similar to the
. Once the Randomazzo has been collected, it will no longer appear on the map.
Alternatively, the Randomazzo can be unlocked in the
, by casting the spell "randomazzami".
In the items panel at the bottom of the Randomazzo, currently obtained items are indicated through a yellow circle and are positioned before unobtained weapons/items.
